decision_question: What unit drives the quoted price?
required_evidence: Dated quote or published pricing; endpoint and technician counts
pass_condition: Per-endpoint, per-technician, site, or flat billing unit is explicit
stop_condition: The price cannot be reproduced from stated quantities

decision_question: Which plan and included capabilities are being purchased?
pass_condition: Required pilot capabilities map to the selected paid plan
stop_condition: A required capability is excluded or requires an unknown upgrade

decision_question: When does the trial end in the buyer's timezone?
required_evidence: Trial start confirmation; account billing page
pass_condition: Exact trial end date and timezone are recorded
stop_condition: Only a relative duration is known

decision_question: When and how much can the first charge be?
required_evidence: Checkout summary; tax estimate; billing terms
pass_condition: First possible charge date and estimated total are recorded
stop_condition: Charge timing or amount remains materially unknown

decision_question: What is the expected recurring total at rollout size?
required_evidence: Quantity model; base price; add-ons; tax treatment
pass_condition: Monthly and annual totals can be independently recalculated
stop_condition: A mandatory add-on or variable charge is missing

decision_question: Which backup, security, remote-access, storage, or support items cost extra?
required_evidence: Add-on schedule; selected options; retained-tool list
pass_condition: Every required add-on and retained tool has an owner and cost
stop_condition: The production design depends on an unpriced add-on

decision_question: What event earns any promotional or founder discount?
required_evidence: Written offer terms; eligibility event; available-position rule
pass_condition: Discount trigger and non-reservation rule are understood
stop_condition: The buyer assumes applying or starting a trial reserves a discount

decision_question: Who may authorize the payment method?
required_evidence: Named business owner; purchasing policy; approval record
pass_condition: Authorized owner approves the payment method and spending limit
stop_condition: An unauthorized technician controls the payment decision

decision_question: Where will invoices, receipts, and tax documents be delivered?
required_evidence: Billing contact; invoice sample or settings; retention location
pass_condition: Records route to an owned mailbox and retained system
stop_condition: Billing records depend on a departing employee or inaccessible inbox

decision_question: What renews, when, and how is cancellation completed?
required_evidence: Subscription terms; cancellation path; notice requirements
pass_condition: Renewal cadence, cancellation steps, and evidence owner are recorded
stop_condition: Cancellation or renewal terms cannot be located

decision_question: How do endpoint or technician changes affect the bill?
required_evidence: Proration terms; quantity-change test or documentation
pass_condition: Increase, decrease, and proration behavior are understood
stop_condition: Normal fleet changes can create unbounded or unexplained cost

decision_question: What happens after a failed charge?
required_evidence: Dunning terms; grace period; service impact; alert route
pass_condition: Payment failure reaches a named owner before operational impact
stop_condition: Service can be interrupted without an accountable alert path

decision_question: Are refunds, credits, or unused time available?
pass_condition: Buyer accepts the documented remedy and limitations
stop_condition: Purchase approval depends on an undocumented refund assumption

decision_question: Did the pilot pass security, monitoring, patching, automation, access, and removal gates?
required_evidence: Completed pilot evidence; exceptions; approver decision
pass_condition: Technical acceptance is signed before paid rollout
stop_condition: Checkout is used to bypass unresolved technical stop conditions

decision_question: What decision will be made before trial expiry?
required_evidence: Named approvers; decision date; evidence pack
pass_condition: Go, limited-go, retest, or no-go is recorded before expiry
stop_condition: The trial drifts into payment without an explicit decision

decision_question: Who verifies the subscription and first invoice?
required_evidence: Named owner; first-invoice review task; escalation route
pass_condition: Owner confirms plan, quantity, discount, tax, and total after purchase
stop_condition: No one is accountable for checking the first invoice
